content.rendered:
Our building will be closed December 22nd through January 2nd for Winter Break. Monday January 5th is a Professional Development day for staff, with no school for students.

Students will return to school on Tuesday, January 6, 2026. We wish everyone a safe and restful break, and we’ll see you in January!
